$comment: Meters a shipped plugin exports that no display of its panel binds, each with the reason (tools/test/meter-binding-check.mjs). An entry goes when a display binds the meter.

omx-comp.compKey: the key's level: no display kind of the closed set (gain_reduction_bar, transfer_curve, eq_response, meter) draws a sidechain level beside the curve; the meter strip reads it

omx-deesser.deessIn: the operating point of the transfer curve: omx-panel binds a curve's in and out only to a measured level meter, and a descriptor meter carries no measurement; it binds when omx-panel reads a descriptor level meter as measured
omx-deesser.deessOut: the operating point of the transfer curve: omx-panel binds a curve's in and out only to a measured level meter, and a descriptor meter carries no measurement; it binds when omx-panel reads a descriptor level meter as measured
